dedupe_keys.name: galileo and egnos programme reference documents gsc electronic library

description: This library page groups the in-force and archived reference documents of the European satellite navigation programmes. Contents: for Galileo the Open Service, Open Service Navigation Message Authentication, High Accuracy Service, Timing Service, Search and Rescue Service and Emergency Warning Satellite Service documents; for EGNOS the Open Service, Safety of Life Service and Data Access Service documents; archived versions of the same. Producer: the European GNSS Service Centre for EUSPA. Coverage: the services available worldwide (Galileo) and across the European EGNOS area. Access: public web pages leading to each document; comments and errors are reported through the Galileo helpdesk and collected in an errata sheet that may be consolidated into a new issue. Licence and cost: free to read; no reuse licence is stated on the page. Caveats: these are specifications, not measurements, and the archived documents describe older service definitions, so the issue number matters. Simulation uses: the signal-in-space and service definitions supply the performance targets and message structures needed when modelling GNSS availability, timing dependence and resilience of dependent infrastructure. The quarterly performance reports (data-galileo-quarterly-performance-reports) give measured values against these definitions.
